acceptance_rule: Every consumer must read canonical promoted data first. No consumer may silently perform its own provider fetch.
canonical_stack: Yahoo Finance via yahooFinance.ts (last resort only, circuit-breaker wrapped)

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData call — Yahoo as primary price source
violations.description: getOrderBookDepth() called fetchTickerData(cleanSym.NS, 10) with no canonical check before it. Used yfData?.summary?.price for current price.
violations.notes: Clean migration. OpportunityDataResolverService handles full canonical waterfall internally.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData call — Yahoo without canonical check first
violations.description: computeMomentumReport() fetched Yahoo data when historicalCandles were insufficient (<60), bypassing DuckDB/DailyOHLCV entirely.
violations.notes: File is @deprecated but still in active use. Migration is safe as candle structure is compatible.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData call — Yahoo without canonical check first
violations.description: analyze() fetched Yahoo data when historicalCandles were insufficient (<30), skipping all canonical SQLite and DuckDB sources.
violations.notes: Compatible migration. Candle field names (date, open, high, low, close, volume) are identical.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData call — Yahoo as PRIMARY source for stock OHLCV
violations.description: analyzeSymbol() called fetchTickerData as the sole data source with no canonical fallback chain before it.
violations.notes: fetchTickerData import retained for ^NSEI benchmark fetch at line 1073 (category-b exception).

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData call — Yahoo as PRIMARY source for CMP/SMA calculation
violations.description: discoverScripUniverse() called fetchTickerData(symbol.NS, 200) as the only price data source; no DuckDB or SQLite check.
violations.notes: Clean migration. fetchTickerData import removed entirely.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData call — Yahoo as PRIMARY source in getMultiTimeframeSmartMoney
violations.description: getMultiTimeframeSmartMoney() called fetchTickerData(yfSym, 365) as the only price data source, with no canonical check, unlike classifySmartMoneyFlow() which already uses DuckDB→SQLite→Yahoo waterfall.
violations.fix: Replaced with OpportunityDataResolverService.getInstance().resolveMarketData(cleanSym, 260); uses snapshot.candles. fetchTickerData import retained for classifySmartMoneyFlow's last-resort path at line 296.
violations.notes: classifySmartMoneyFlow() (line 296) correctly follows canonical waterfall already and is not migrated.

violations.description: POST /api/data-pipeline/backfill-yahoo constructs YAHOO_BASE URL and fetches directly. This is a DATA INGESTION pipeline tool that writes to canonical DailyOHLCV table.
violations.notes: Exempted: This is the ingestor, not a consumer. It writes TO the canonical DailyOHLCV table. Migrating would break the ingestion pipeline.

violations.description: POST /api/data-pipeline/fast-backfill also constructs YAHOO_BASE URL for gap-fill. Same ingestion pipeline tool.
violations.notes: Exempted: Data ingestion pipeline. Writes to canonical DailyOHLCV. Not a consumer violation.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData call for benchmark index ^CRSLDX
violations.description: getBenchmark180dReturn() fetches Nifty 500 (^CRSLDX) and ^NSEI via Yahoo. Index data is not in canonical DailyOHLCV table.
violations.notes: Pending: Benchmark index OHLCV (^CRSLDX, ^NSEI) not stored in canonical equity DailyOHLCV. Requires adding index data to canonical store first.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData calls for global market indices and forex
violations.description: getMacroSnapshot() fetches ^NSEI, ^INDIAVIX, ^GSPC, ^IXIC, DX-Y.NYB, BZ=F, ^TNX, USDINR=X via Yahoo. None of these are in canonical equity OHLCV.
violations.notes: Pending: Global indices and forex data not in canonical store. Requires dedicated macro data table.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData call for ^NSEI benchmark index
violations.description: analyzeSymbol() fetches ^NSEI for SMT Divergence benchmark candles via Yahoo. Index data not in canonical equity table.
violations.notes: Pending: Benchmark index data not in canonical DailyOHLCV. fetchTickerData import retained specifically for this call.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData as step-5 fallback in live price lookup
violations.description: getLivePrice() already checks 4 canonical sources (OpportunityScripEvaluations, Holdings, Prices, Screener cache) before calling Yahoo as step 5.
violations.notes: Borderline compliant: Yahoo is already a last resort after 4 canonical/local checks. No action needed unless a dedicated live-price canonical layer is added.

violations.pattern: direct fetchTickerData as last-resort in classifySmartMoneyFlow
violations.description: classifySmartMoneyFlow() checks DuckDB then SQLite (HistoricalPrices) before calling fetchTickerData. Yahoo is step 3 of an explicit canonical waterfall.
violations.notes: Already compliant: canonical waterfall (DuckDB→SQLite→Yahoo) is already in place. No migration needed.

additional_findings.AutonomousSmartMoneyAgent.ts: Imports fetchTickerData but no direct call found in the file body. Import appears unused. Not a runtime violation.
additional_findings.camsParser.ts:511: Queries Yahoo Finance Search API for ISIN resolution — different use case (symbol mapping, not OHLCV). Not in scope of this audit.
additional_findings.DuckDB_direct_calls: stockscans/MarketDataQueryService.ts opens a local SQLite evidence DB (fere_evidence.db) for universe symbol lists — not DuckDB market data. Not a violation.
additional_findings.ZerodhaSyncService.ts: Uses kiteconnect for official Zerodha holdings sync — this is the sanctioned Zerodha integration path, not a rogue provider call.
